children: Clean Energy Technologies entered into a securities purchase agreement with Walnut Capital to raise working capital. The company issued a $166,500 convertible promissory note for $150,000 in net funding, carrying a one-time 12% interest charge and maturing on Sep 08, 2027. The note is amortized through 10 monthly payments of $18,648 starting Dec 08, 2026, and is convertible upon default at 85% of the lowest closing bid over the prior 10 trading days, subject to 4.99% ownership and Nasdaq Rule 5635(d) limits.
: Convertible promissory note financing via securities purchase agreement
